from pathlib import Path
import re
html=Path('/tmp/upstream-index.html').read_text()
css=Path('/tmp/fa-6.4.0-all.min.css').read_text()
print('stylesheets:')
for x in re.findall(r'<link[^>]+href=["\']([^"\']+)', html, re.I): print(x)
# literal configured icon values
items=re.findall(r'\{\s*name:\s*["\']([^"\']+)["\']\s*,\s*icon:\s*["\']([^"\']+)["\']\s*\}',html)
print('items=',len(items))
present=missing=0
for name, classes in items:
    icon=next((c for c in classes.split() if c.startswith('fa-') and c not in {'fa-solid','fa-regular','fa-brands'}),None)
    # CSS selector can be followed by comma or :before
    hit=bool(icon and re.search(r'\.'+re.escape(icon)+r'(?=[:,.{\s])',css))
    print(f'{name:10} {classes:30} selector={"present" if hit else "MISSING"}')
    present += hit; missing += not hit
print(f'count total={len(items)} present={present} missing={missing}')
PY
